moments.title: Commonwealth Games Glasgow 2026 Underway
moments.blurb: The Commonwealth Games in Glasgow are in full swing, running until August 2nd, with Scotland and England already securing gold medals.

angles.name: General Update
angles.copy: Another day, another medal haul at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow! Who are you cheering on this week?

angles.name: Scottish Pride
angles.copy: Glasgow is buzzing! Scotland's already on the board with a gold at the Commonwealth Games. What a start!

moments.title: Chart Battle: Dai Dai vs Rein Me In
moments.blurb: Shakira and Burna Boy's World Cup anthem 'Dai Dai' is battling Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' for the UK Number 1 spot, with 'Rein Me In' having equalled the record for most weeks at the top.

angles.name: Chart Race
angles.copy: Massive chart battle brewing! Can Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' dethrone Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's record-equalling 'Rein Me In'? Tune in Friday!

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: 'Rein Me In' just made history, tying for the longest-running UK Number 1! Can Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold on for the outright record?

moments.title: Y-Not Festival Kicks Off This Week
moments.blurb: Y-Not Festival returns to Derbyshire from July 30th to August 2nd, featuring headliners like The Libertines, Reytons, Two Door Cinema Club, and The Streets.

angles.name: Festival Excitement
angles.copy: Derbyshire is getting ready to rock! Y-Not Festival is just days away with The Libertines, The Streets & more. Who are you buzzing to see?

angles.name: Indie Anthems
angles.copy: Get your indie anthems ready! Y-Not Festival is bringing the best of British rock & indie to Derbyshire this weekend.

moments.title: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival
moments.blurb: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival runs from July 30th to August 1st in the Scottish Highlands, with James, The Human League, and Callum Beattie headlining.

angles.name: Scottish Festival
angles.copy: The Scottish Highlands are calling! Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival is almost here with James, The Human League & more. Ready for a weekend of music?

angles.name: Highland Vibes
angles.copy: Grab your wellies, Belladrum is just around the corner! Who's heading to the Tartan Heart Festival for some legendary acts?

moments.title: Camp Bestival Dorset Returns
moments.blurb: Camp Bestival Dorset takes over Lulworth Castle from July 30th to August 2nd, featuring Bastille, Fatboy Slim, Billy Ocean, and Self Esteem.

angles.name: Family Festival Fun
angles.copy: Lulworth Castle is gearing up for Camp Bestival Dorset! Four days of music, magic, and family fun with Bastille, Fatboy Slim & more. Who's packing their glitter?

angles.name: Diverse Lineup
angles.copy: From dance legends to pop anthems, Camp Bestival Dorset has it all this weekend! Get ready for a huge lineup.

moments.title: Grace Jones Headlines Palace Bowl Presents
moments.blurb: The iconic Grace Jones will headline Palace Bowl Presents at Crystal Palace Bowl in London on July 31st, with special guests Sophie Ellis-Bextor and Soul II Soul.

angles.name: Legendary Performance
angles.copy: Grace Jones is coming to London! Catch the icon at Crystal Palace Bowl on July 31st with Sophie Ellis-Bextor & Soul II Soul. What a lineup!

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is set for a legendary night! Grace Jones, Sophie Ellis-Bextor, Soul II Soul – London, are you ready?

moments.blurb: The legendary frontman of The Rolling Stones, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the one and only Mick Jagger! The Rolling Stones legend is still bringing the moves and the hits. What's your favourite Stones track?

angles.name: Ageless Rockstar
angles.copy: 83 years young and still rocking! Sending birthday wishes to the incredible Mick Jagger today. He's got the moves like...

moments.title: Roger Taylor Turns 77
moments.blurb: Queen's iconic drummer, Roger Taylor, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the legendary Roger Taylor of Queen! What's your favourite Queen song that showcases his incredible drumming?

angles.name: Queen's Beat
angles.copy: He gave us the beat to so many anthems! Sending birthday love to Queen's Roger Taylor today.

moments.title: Darlene Love Turns 85
moments.blurb: The legendary American singer Darlene Love, known for her powerful vocals and Christmas classic 'Christmas (Baby Please Come Home)', celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Soulful Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 85th Birthday to the incredible Darlene Love! Her voice is pure magic. What's your favourite Darlene Love song?

angles.name: Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Celebrating the magnificent Darlene Love on her 85th birthday! A voice that truly stands the test of time.

moments.title: Taylor Momsen Turns 33
moments.blurb: The lead singer of The Pretty Reckless and former actress, Taylor Momsen, celebrates her 33rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Chick Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 33rd Birthday to the powerhouse voice of The Pretty Reckless, Taylor Momsen! What's your favourite track from the band?

angles.name: Modern Rock
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Taylor Momsen! Keep those rock anthems coming!

moments.title: Drought Declared in Parts of Wales
moments.blurb: Parts of Wales have been officially declared in drought, with July on course to be the driest in nearly 200 years, leading to concerns about water supplies and wildfires.

angles.name: Welsh Weather Alert
angles.copy: Critical update for Wales: Parts of the nation are now officially in drought after the driest July in almost two centuries. Please conserve water where you can.

angles.name: Local Impact
angles.copy: With drought declared in parts of Wales, it's a stark reminder of our changing climate. How is the dry weather affecting your local area?

moments.title: Wales Secures £4.5m Cycling Investment
moments.blurb: The Welsh Government has announced a £4.5 million investment in cycling tourism infrastructure across Wales, aiming to create a lasting legacy from the Tour de France Grand Départ in 2027.

angles.name: Cycling Boost
angles.copy: Great news for cyclists in Wales! A £4.5m investment will boost cycling tourism and infrastructure ahead of the Tour de France Grand Départ next year.

angles.name: Tour de France Legacy
angles.copy: Preparing for the Tour de France in 2027, the Welsh Government is investing £4.5m into cycling infrastructure. Get ready to hit those trails!

moments.title: Devon Councils Eye Legal Challenge
moments.blurb: Devon County Council is preparing legal steps to challenge the government's proposed reorganisation of local government, which could see the county carved into new unitary councils.

angles.name: Local Politics
angles.copy: Big news for Devon! Our County Council is taking the first steps towards a legal challenge against government plans for local government reorganisation. What are your thoughts on the proposed changes?

angles.name: Future of Devon
angles.copy: The future of local governance in Devon is being hotly debated, with a potential legal challenge on the horizon. Stay tuned for updates on how this could impact our communities.

moments.title: Summer Nights at the Bandstand Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 'Summer Nights at the Bandstand' music series returns to Kelvingrove Park, Glasgow, from July 27th, running until August 15th.

angles.name: Glasgow Gigs
angles.copy: Summer Nights at the Bandstand is back in Glasgow from tomorrow! Get ready for some fantastic live music in Kelvingrove Park.

angles.name: Park Life
angles.copy: Live music in the heart of Glasgow! Summer Nights at the Bandstand kicks off tomorrow. Who are you hoping to see perform?
